full_cash_identity.period_formula: tariff_neutral_FCF = reported_FCF + P - R - C + V - I
full_cash_identity.P: gross IEEPA duty cash paid in the period
full_cash_identity.R: gross IEEPA refund cash collected in the period
full_cash_identity.C: original vendor/partner concessions realized as cash benefit in the period; not the accounting accrual
full_cash_identity.V: cash reimbursements actually paid to those vendors/partners
full_cash_identity.I: related refund-interest CASH receipts included in CFO (income recognized5.6m is not exact cash proof)
full_cash_identity.current_other_adjustments: Subtract actual net pension termination cash benefit, approximately100m. Subtract Dickies standalone FCF D_current, if estimated, and label it. Prior uses D_prior. Do not subtract sale proceeds from FCF because they are already investing, not CFO.
